Comment.description: What a person wrote, on which trace, in which workspace, and when.
Comment.title: Comment

Config.description: ``config.json``: what the UIs need of the deployment they run in.
Config.title: Config

CreatedTenant.description:
The tenant a creation made, and its owner.

The owner is by the user id their tokens carry, never by email.
CreatedTenant.title: CreatedTenant

DaySpend.description: What was spent on one day, in UTC: dollars, tokens and requests.
DaySpend.title: DaySpend

DeploymentTenants.description: Every tenant, and their spend, as one LiteLLM team list reads it.
DeploymentTenants.title: DeploymentTenants

Evaluation.description: One evaluator's score of one name, per day, and over the window.
Evaluation.title: Evaluation

Feedback.description: The window's feedback and evaluations, and whether every score was read.
Feedback.title: Feedback

FieldError.description: One problem FastAPI found with a request's parameters or body.
FieldError.title: FieldError

Invited.description: The member an invitation made, by the user id their tokens carry.
Invited.title: Invited

Links.description: Deep links into the stack's own tools, which only operators get.
Links.title: Links

LogRecord.description: One log record, without its line unless that was asked for.
LogRecord.title: LogRecord

Logs.description: A window's records, newest first, and whether they are all of them.
Logs.title: Logs

Mean.description: An evaluation's scores on one day: how many, and their mean; None for a day with none.
Mean.title: Mean

Names.description:
The emails of the people asked after whom the caller may see, by user id.

An id left out is one the caller may not see, one with no user, or one with no email, and the
answer is the same for all three.

NewInvite.description: Whom to invite to the tenant ``X-Tenant`` names.
NewInvite.title: NewInvite

NewTenant.description: A tenant to create, and the email of its first owner.
NewTenant.title: NewTenant

Refused.description:
The body of a refused request.

``detail`` is the rejection, the message of a resolver's refusal, or the problems FastAPI
found with the request.
Refused.title: Refused

RejectionDetail.description: A rejection, as REST sends it: its ``type``, its ``message`` and its typed details.
RejectionDetail.title: RejectionDetail

Score.description: A score: a person's feedback, or an evaluator's verdict, on a trace.
Score.title: Score

Scores.description: The scores a read took, whether they are all there were, and since when they are known.
Scores.title: Scores

Span.description: One span of a trace, with its attributes flattened to values.
Span.title: Span

Spend.description: What a tenant has spent, against its budget, if it has one.
Spend.title: Spend

Supabase.description: The Supabase project the UIs sign in to.
Supabase.title: Supabase

Surfaces.description: Where the application mounts each router, as the UIs' client calls them.
Surfaces.title: Surfaces

Thumbs.description: People's thumbs on one day, in UTC.
Thumbs.title: Thumbs

TraceSummary.description:
A trace Tempo found: its id, start and duration.

Its root's service and name are left out, since the root may be another tenant's span.
TraceSummary.title: TraceSummary

Unavailable.description: The tool didn't answer, or answered with an error; ``reason`` says which.
Unavailable.title: Unavailable

Unconfigured.description: The application runs without this tool.
Unconfigured.title: Unconfigured

Usage.description: The window's spend per day, each workspace's, the team's budget, and whether all was read.
Usage.title: Usage

WorkspaceSpend.description: One workspace's spend over the window.
WorkspaceSpend.title: WorkspaceSpend

WorkspaceTotals.description: One workspace's thumbs and evaluations; None for traces tagged with no workspace.
WorkspaceTotals.title: WorkspaceTotals

get.description: What the UIs need of this deployment: Supabase, the surfaces, and the tools it runs.
Deep links into Langfuse and Grafana, which aren't tenant-scoped, for operators.
Every tenant, with its spend from one LiteLLM team list, for operators.

post.description:
Create a tenant, with its first owner invited, or found, by email, for operators.

Only operators, who may create tenants, get past the checks, which come before Supabase is
asked about anyone: a tenant that exists is refused without an invitation, so a repeated
request invites no one again and creates nothing twice. The email is never logged or
answered with: the answer names the tenant and the owner's user id.

502.description: Supabase Auth didn't invite or find the owner: `invite_failed`

get.description:
The tenant's feedback and evaluations from Langfuse, or one workspace's, by day.

The window is at most 91 days. Every score in it is read and summed, within the read's
bounds: ``complete`` is false where one was reached.

schema.title: Response Feedback Portalr V1 Feedback Get

post.description:
Invite someone to the tenant: Supabase Auth creates or finds them, grantr adds them.

It needs ``grantr:add_member``, which is checked before Supabase is asked, and again
when grantr adds the member. Inviting a member again succeeds, and changes nothing.

502.description: Supabase Auth didn't invite or find the person: `invite_failed`

get.description:
The tenant's logs, a thread's or a run's, from Loki, without their lines.

A record has its time, level, service, thread, run and its line's length, and the labels
known to be safe; the line and the other labels are withheld, and named.

schema.title: Response Logs Portalr V1 Logs Get

get.description: One of the tenant's log records by its id, with its line: asked for, and not kept.

schema.title: Response Log Line Portalr V1 Logs  Record Id  Get

get.description: The tenant's latency or errors over time, from Prometheus, through prom-label-proxy.

schema.title: Response Metrics Portalr V1 Metrics Get

get.description:
The emails of people, by user id: of the tenant ``X-Tenant`` names, for its members.

A member of the tenant sees its other members' emails; an operator sees anyone's, with no
tenant. An id the caller may not see, with no user or with no email, is left out, alike,
and Supabase is asked only about the ids the caller may see. At most 100 ids. The answer
is personal data and is not to be kept, so it is ``no-store``.
The tenant's feedback and evaluation scores, from Langfuse, and whether that's all.

schema.title: Response Scores Portalr V1 Scores Get

get.description: The tenant's usage and spend, against its budget, from its LiteLLM team.

schema.title: Response Spend Portalr V1 Spend Get

get.description: The tenant's traces, a session's or a run's, from Tempo.

schema.title: Response Traces Portalr V1 Traces Get

get.description:
A trace, if it is the tenant's: its spans, for its waterfall.

Only the attributes known to be safe are shown. ``content=true`` and ``span`` ask for one
span's others, its prompt and completion among them, and nothing of any other span's; the
answer is not to be kept.

schema.title: Response Trace Portalr V1 Traces  Trace Id  Get

get.description:
The tenant's spend per day from LiteLLM, and each named workspace's, with its budget.

The window is at most 91 days, and the read is bounded: ``complete`` is false where it
stopped at a bound. Only the named workspaces' tags are asked after.

schema.title: Response Usage Portalr V1 Usage Get
